spellbook.finance/limitations: workspaceId validates caller ownership only. This account-scoped preference can affect future listing or repricing work across all of the caller's workspaces.
The write requires agent_marketplace_publish authorization. If a delegated agent sets this preference, later bootstrap use is also denied when the owner's publish flag is off.
Saving the mode does not update or verify eBay fulfillment policies, listing association, or buyer checkout.

description: Save the seller-selected shipping mode for the caller's connected eBay account, then return the saved preference. Read spellbook_ebay_shipping_mode_get first; call spellbook_ebay_shipping_policy_set separately to configure charges. This can affect future listing and repricing work across the account's workspaces.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

shippingMode.description: Seller-selected account preference: buyer_pays_flat or free_baked_in. Required.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_shipping_mode_set
